recap.headline: Week Two Closes, Eshan's Chip Talk Dies
recap.subhead: Luka dropped 45 and the manager who sold him as a title lock still lost the week by a single category.

zingers.team: Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw
zingers.line: Luka went 45 PTS, 15 REB, 8 3PTM and the week still ended 5-6; Eshan B called himself champion and sits 8th.
Kris Dunn dropped 7 STL off the wire and stole the week 6-5; the lazy rival's Luka monster night got wasted.
Scottie Barnes went 11-20 for 29 points and the team still lost 1-8 on the night; power rank bottom, earned.
Punting PTS and ST while taking a 1-7 night against BrookynDynasty is not strategy, it is surrender with extra steps.
Nobody played for them last night, and they still posted the league's best TO line, a perfect 0 turnovers from an empty roster.
Franz Wagner shot 5-20 and Gopher Gold still hung an 8-1 night on MONSTARS; the top seed is beating up on corpses.
The unluckiest team in the league lost the week 8-3 while punting FG%, so the luck excuse has a body count of one.

night: Luka Dončić, Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw: 45 PTS, 15 REB, 6 AST, 8 3PTM. Best line of the night, and it still lost the week.
Scottie Barnes, MONSTARS ☄️: 29 PTS on 11-20 FG. Volume without efficiency, and the night went 1-8 anyway.
No bench blunders were logged last night, so the managers get a pass they did not earn.
Rui Hachimura went 24 PTS, 4 3PTM on 10-16 FG and is still on the wire. Jamison Battle, 20 PTS, also still sitting there.
Thug Life had the best night, 5-4-2 against Adam Silver Dez Nuts. MONSTARS ☄️ had the worst, 1-8-2 against Gopher Gold.
